name: Black Whale Guard AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by skirmishers and cavalry.

items.name: Club
items.description: This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.

items.name: Nightmare Cudgel
items.description:
Crafted from polished wood, this seemingly mundane +1 striking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Club] comes with a red leather strap near the handle. The mere sight of the cudgel in a guard's hand fills prisoners with dread.

Good creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 2} while carrying, wielding, or wearing this item crafted by the sea-witches.

Activate 2 Interact (emotion, mental)

Frequency once per day

Effect You initiate an intimidating walk, thumping the cudgel menacingly against your palm. As part of activating this item, you can Stride twice. For the next minute, whenever you successfully Strike a creature with the nightmare cudgel, you can use a free action to attempt an Intimidation check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Demoralize] the struck creature.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.description: A suit of chain mail consists of several pieces of armor composed of small metal rings linked together in a protective mesh. It typically includes a chain shirt, leggings, a pair of arms, and a coif, collectively protecting most of the body.

defensiveAbilities.name: No Escape
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An enemy within reach of the Black Whale guard attempts to move away

Effect The guard Strides up to their Speed, following the enemy and keeping the enemy in reach throughout its movement until the enemy stops moving or the guard moves their full Speed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Clobber
offensiveAbilities.description: The guard makes a club Strike. On a hit, if the target is Off-Guard, the target must succeed at a DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be Stunned 2.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hammering Flurry
offensiveAbilities.description: The guard makes three club Strikes against a single target, ignoring the multiple attack penalty until after all three attacks are completed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shatter Defenses
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A Frightened creature is within melee reach of the Black Whale guard

Effect The guard makes a melee Strike against the frightened creature. If they hit and deal damage, the target becomes Off-Guard as long as it's frightened. If the target is already off-guard, it can't reduce its frightened value below 1 until the start of the guard's next turn.
